items.author: Matthew Baszucki
items.text:
8 most critical metabolic therapies for mental illness. Ordered by overall impact (personal list, based on my experience). These put my bipolar disorder into remission.

1. Ketogenic diet, preferably carnivore
2. Cut out drugs & alcohol
3. Physical exercise (hard cardio + weights)
4. Sunlight exposure first thing in the morning, throughout the day, in evening
5. Keep stress low
6. Sleep
7. Prayer, meditation, spiritual life
8. Time with others

In The Birth of Tragedy, Nietzsche writes that existence and the world are justified aesthetically.

His aim is thus parallel to Milton’s in Paradise Lost, only the justification does not reference God.

items.author: Bryan Johnson
items.text:
Slowing brain aging is one of the hardest things to solve.

The first step is to understand the specific proteins and metabolites driving accelerated brain aging. 

MRI brain-age clocks plus genomics, proteomics, and metabolomics identifies molecular correlates.
